text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['proto'] == 'tcp') | ((df['swin'] == 0) & (df['dwin'] == 0) & (df['stcpb'] == 0) & (df['dtcpb'] == 0) & (df['tcprtt'] == 0) & (df['synack'] == 0) & (df['ackdat'] == 0))"],"features":["proto","swin","dwin","stcpb","dtcpb","tcprtt","synack","ackdat"],"rationale":"TCP window, sequence-number, and connection-setup measurements are absent for non-TCP flows and are represented as zero."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] == 'ftp') | ((df['is_ftp_login'] == 0) & (df['ct_ftp_cmd'] == 0))"],"features":["service","is_ftp_login","ct_ftp_cmd"],"rationale":"FTP login and FTP command features cannot be present when the flow is not classified as FTP."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] == 'http') | ((df['ct_flw_http_mthd'] == 0) & (df['trans_depth'] == 0) & (df['response_body_len'] == 0))"],"features":["service","ct_flw_http_mthd","trans_depth","response_body_len"],"rationale":"HTTP method, transaction-depth, and HTTP response-body features are absent for flows not classified as HTTP."}]}
